entry_item.definition: n. Noise made by a crowd of people; singing or whistling (of wind, etc.).

example.definition: To make a noise; to cause people to talk about something.

example.unicode: ᠳᠠᠶᠢᠰᠤᠨ ᠢᠷᠡᠯᠡ ᠭᠡᠵᠦ ᠶᠡᠺᠡ ᠱᠣᠣᠺᠢᠶᠠᠨ ᠪᠣᠯᠵᠤ ᠪᠠᠶᠢᠨ᠎ᠠ
example.transcript: daisun irele gezy jeke -- bolzu bain-a
example.definition: There is noisy talk or a rumor that the enemy is approaching.
